author: HXSHX SAMA
title: Paid novel-cover commission: girl in glowing lilies
content:
Hey, hello artists! I'm looking for a commission. I'm Thai and willing to pay for the commission. My concept is... 

- A girl in a school uniform is standing in a field of glowing lilies on a starry night, holding a drawing board and pencils.
#Vgencommission

Follow-up: I have many more details to use for my novel cover and for copyright purposes. I will credit the owner of the image for respect. Please feel free to suggest anything. Contact: reply on the post / X DM.

author: Chaffee (채피)
title: Night Elf OC commission inquiry
content:
I have a Night Elf OC, and with the recent release of WC3 Definitive Edition I became interested in looking for an artist to commission an art for her, preferably from someone already familiar with Night Elves.
I'd like to inquire your rates and discuss a request. Thank you. Contact: reply or X DM.
